purpose: Resolve the 0.70-0.75 interval after stage 1 showed uniform negative pre-quasi-extinction response through 0.70 and nonparallel labels only with mass collapse at 0.75.
primary_decision: Count mixed or positive histories at epsilon 0 and 0.01 separately among histories whose six terminal masses are all >=1.
additional_reporting: fraction of start-arm cells below mass 1
stopping: execute and report all four levels; no extra level is added in this stage after outcomes are inspected
claim_boundary: A mass >=1 endpoint is only a minimum non-sub-individual condition.
No natural inbreeding-depression threshold is inferred.
If no pre-quasi-extinction nonparallel history appears through 0.74, depression-0.75 nonparallelism is removed from the headline and retained only as a low-mass closure diagnostic.
